sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Differs from Mirocapritermes connectens in the relatively shorter and broader mandibles, the larger body and the shorter 2nd antennal segment. M. valeriae is larger, with a straighter anterior margin of the labrum and a stronger hook at the tip of the left mandible. In M. concaveus the labrum is more deeply and widely concave, the mandibles longer and more slender, and the hook at the tip of the left mandible stronger. M. prewensis differs in the shape of the labrum and postmentum, the more slender mandibles and the larger dimensions.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, slightly paler behind; labrum milk-white with transparent margins; mandibles dark brown; antennae pale brown with transparent tips to the segments; pronotum yellow with a brownish tinge. Head with numerous long and short setae, denser on the frontal projection than on the rest of the head capsule; tip of the labrum with 2 setae; postmentum bare; pronotum less hairy than the head. Head rectangular, the frontal projection broadly rounded in lateral view. Labrum much longer than wide, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the anterolateral corners drawn out into moderately long processes. Mandibles asymmetrical, broad, shorter than the head capsule (measured to the tip of the frontal projection); left mandible strongly curved in the middle, the tip bluntly pointed and faintly hooked; right mandible sabre-shaped, narrowed and pointed at the tip, without a hook, slightly longer than the left. Postmentum 1.5 times as long as its greatest width, the waist only faintly indicated. Antennae 14-segmented, the 2nd segment as long as the 3rd and slightly shorter than the 5th, the 4th the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum convex, slightly concave in the middle; posterior margin not concave in the middle. Measurements (mm, holotype and paratype soldier given in that order): head length (to the tip of the frontal projection) 1.30, 1.22; head width 0.96, 0.91; head height 0.85, 0.80; left mandible length 1.06, 0.98; right mandible length 1.10, 1.04; postmentum length 0.65, 0.65; postmentum greatest width 0.27, 0.27; postmentum least width 0.18, 0.18; pronotal length 0.23, 0.23; pronotal width 0.57, 0.55.

note: Adapted from Ahmad's 1965 description of the soldier of the new species Mirocapritermes latignathus; the original is in English. The original gives the measurements in "Mm." (i.e. millimetres), the two columns being the holotype and the paratype in that order. Only the soldier is described; neither the alate nor the worker is described (the worker is merely recorded as collected), hence only the Soldier and Diagnostic characters sections are given. Type locality: Ka-Chong; two soldiers (holotype and paratype) and workers, collected by M. Ahmad on 9 March 1962 (month 3, day 9). A point of identification doubt must be recorded: in the same paper, from p. 98 on, the section on Pericapritermes lists Pericapritermes latignathus (Holmgren), the first entry of the synonymy being "Capritermes (Capritermes) latignathus Holmgren, 1914, pp. 280-281 (soldier, worker)", whose soldiers (p. 99, 10 specimens) have a head length (to the mandibular base) of 2.65—3.17 mm, clearly different from this species (head length to the frontal projection 1.22—1.30 mm); both names appear side by side in the list at the end of the paper. The two share the same specific epithet but belong to different genera, Mirocapritermes and Pericapritermes, so they are not homonyms; this entry records the species as described in the original and makes no taxonomic change.
